_comment: Runtime configuration for the wiki-ingester worker, read by the SPAWNER (wiki-cycle or an interactive session) BEFORE launching workers — not by the worker itself. model_default: any model name the harness's Agent tool accepts (e.g. 'sonnet', 'opus', 'haiku', 'fable' — update freely as new models release; this file exists precisely so a model change is a config edit, not an agent-definition edit). large_raw_kb / large_raw_model (task #239, Mark 2026-11-09): a raw of large_raw_kb or more on disk is written by a worker on large_raw_model, the rest on model_default; `wiki-cycle-scope.py writer <raw>` applies it, and wiki-cycle Step 2 routes by it (on 10 sources Opus left 2 unsupported sentences to Sonnet's 17, with about twice the content on raws of 10 KB+; every transcript of 15+ minutes in agentic-design was 15 KB or more, so this replaced the long-transcript rule for writers). confirm_model_each_run: false (the default since 2026-10-22, task #199) = the spawner uses these settings without asking and the spawn receipt names the models used; it asks only when the user asked to choose the model for that run (three cycles in a row asked, every answer was the default, and the question blocked a run while Mark was away). true = the spawner asks the user which model to use for this batch, offering model_default as the default, WHEN the session can ask (interactive); a session that cannot ask (autonomous / unattended / a scheduled run) uses model_default without asking and names the model it used in its spawn receipt (2026-09-13, defect 5 of the 2026-09-12 batch). The chosen model is passed as the Agent tool's spawn-time 'model' override. Fallback if this file is missing or unread: the AGENT.md frontmatter (model: sonnet), opus from 10 KB.
